The '''Cutting weaves''' are a kind of weave in the [[One Power]] used in a duel among [[channeller]]s to cut and so dispel the forming weaves of an adversary. It is woven differently by women and men. Women's weaves are composed of threads of Fire and Air and in some cases the threads of fire can be reinforced by Earth. For men the weave is composed of spirit, fire and earth.

[[Hessalam]] during the battle in [[Thakan'dar Valley]] showed a great ability in cutting down the attacks of her opponents.

Another example is when [[Rand al'Thor]] used this weave to cut off the weaves that [[Lanfear]] was using to cause [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] and [[Aviendha]] agony in [[Cairhien]].
